description: Unsigned steps to place an order on the X Layer voucher market (Seaport): kind list (sell one voucher you hold, price in OKB), offer (bid on one voucher, paid in WOKB) or coll (bid on any voucher). The seller pays a 0.75% OwlGate fee on fill. Steps: approve/wrap if needed, sign typed data (free), POST to /bids. The wallet signs itself; OwlGate never holds funds.
name: xl_build_order
title: Build an X Layer Voucher Order (unsigned)
